# Consumption Velocity & Horizon

*Navigation: [[index|← StashStats Index]] / [[analytics-overview|Analytics Engine]] / Consumption Velocity & Horizon*
*Siblings: [[analytics-distributions|Categorical Distributions]] · [[analytics-projects|Project Analytics]]*

Consumption velocity calculates historical fiber usage rates and projects how long current inventory will last (the "Stash Horizon").

## Velocity Calculation Engine

`StashVelocityCalculator` extracts chronological delta events (additions, usage, sales, and discards) from item update logs:

```{.python include="../src/stashstats/analytics/velocity.py" snippet="velocity-calculator"}
```

## Velocity Metrics

- **Gross Inflow**: Total yards/grams acquired within rolling time windows (30d, 90d, 365d).
- **Net Consumption**: Yards/grams incorporated into finished projects.
- **Burn Rate**: Average daily consumption velocity.
- **Stash Lifespan Horizon**: Projected exhaustion date calculated by dividing remaining active inventory by 90-day rolling consumption velocity.
